deviations_from_card: (1) There is still one leak rule. The card's Flow names a 'withholds(item.text, line)'. Instead, the existing rules/maths leaks() (explain.ts's rule, 615b523) was extended and hint.ts calls it. leaks() now substitutes into equationOf(question) ?? question, so explain keeps its behaviour on bare practice equations. It also ORs in the new leaksByForm(). No second leak function exists: leaksByForm is the form half of leaks, and nothing else calls it. (2) New exports are appended at the end of rules/maths.ts: equationOf, expressionOf, leaksByForm, withheldLine. leaks() changed in its body only, with the same signature. (3) The bracket-root check also covers equation items: a bracket the item does not already show, whose root satisfies the equation, e.g. '(x − 6)' for 3x − 7 = 11. The card scoped the form check to expressions. This tightens explain as well as hint. (4) A re-ask that throws is handled like a second leak: the withheld line is returned with next '', and the job does not fail. The card did not specify this. It is pinned in case 3. (5) Case 7's reference to tools/maths-rules-test.cjs is covered in two ways. The same two calls are replayed in withhold-rules-test, and a one-line assert.equal(seen.length,2) was added to maths-rules-test's hint case. That is a test file outside the listed write set, which the brief allows. (6) The lab's '3 and 4' leak term for the factor item is not derived: a bare number-pair check would flag method talk. Only the bracket and equivalent-form terms are derived. (7) Main-tree npm test was red twice, both times on sibling in-flight paths only. Run 1: linga review cases 1-6 in linga-rules-test.cjs (linga B's uncommitted review.ts). Run 2: a SyntaxError in desk/src/lib/desk/essay.ts:89 (desk-pipelines B mid-edit). essay-rules and desk-jobs 'rewrite' cases were also red one by one. So the full gate was taken on a clean git-archive copy of HEAD, and every suite plus tsc was green there.
notes: TV and voice degradation (checked, no TV change): a withheld hint is plain text in hint1/hint2.hint with next ''. MathsTV HintScreen (desk/src/maths/MathsTV.tsx ~722-723) renders prose(hh.hint) and hides the arrow row when next is empty ({hh?.next && ...}). The On Air HintScreen (desk/src/tv/screens.tsx ~175-176) does the same with cap-next. desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx:65 speaks hh.hint, so the withheld line is read aloud. Stage 2 gets previous = the withheld line, which is harmless. The withheld lines are 17-20 words with no digits and no number words (leaks() reads 'one'..'twenty' as numbers): equation / factor / expand / a generic line. No Playwright capture was needed because no TV screen changed. The gate applies only to subject 'maths'. English and essay hints are unchanged. Scope matches the card: single-variable equations and one-variable Factor/Expand items. Systems, word problems, slope items and Simplify-with-y have no oracle (equationOf/expressionOf return null) and stay unchecked. Remaining risk: leaks() flags any number that verify accepts, including the unsigned form of a signed one. On an item whose root also appears in the item text (e.g. 2x² − 5x − 3 = 0, root 3), a hint quoting 'the -3' would be re-asked. It does not occur in the 24 recorded stages. The lab's poc_hints.leaks only flagged bare small numbers in an answer-shaped context. Aligning with that would loosen explain, so it was not done here. For vision-lab B (bench): hint() now makes at most 2 text calls per stage, and a replayed leaky fixture will see a re-ask. Its 'leaked' tally should score the line hint() returns, not the raw fixture.
